verses.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا

trs.20: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
trs.85: Exalted is He who has sent the Differentiator down to His servant so that it may be a warning to all people.
trs.22: Blessed is He who sent down the criterion to His servant, that it may be an admonition to all creatures;-
trs.203: Blessed be He Who sent down the criterion (of right and wrong, i.e. this Qur’ân) to His slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that he may be a warner to the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا

trs.20: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
trs.85: It is He who has control over the heavens and earth and has no offspring––no one shares control with Him––and who created all things and made them to an exact measure.
trs.22: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: no son has He begotten, nor has He a partner in His dominion: it is He who created all things, and ordered them in due proportions.
trs.203: He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Who has begotten no son (children or offspring) and for Whom there is no partner in the dominion. He has created everything, and has measured it exactly according to its due measurements.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا

trs.20: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
trs.85: Yet the disbelievers take as their gods things beneath Him that create nothing, and are themselves created, that can neither harm nor help themselves, and have no control over death, life, or resurrection.
trs.22: Yet have they taken, besides him, gods that can create nothing but are themselves created; that have no control of hurt or good to themselves; nor can they control death nor life nor resurrection.
trs.203: Yet they have taken besides Him other alîhâh (gods) who created nothing but are themselves created, and possess neither harm nor benefit for themselves, and possess no power (of causing) death, nor (of giving) life, nor of raising the dead.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا

trs.20: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
trs.85: The disbelievers say, ‘This can only be a lie he has forged with the help of others’––they themselves have done great wrong and told lies––
trs.22: But the misbelievers say: "Naught is this but a lie which he has forged, and others have helped him at it." In truth it is they who have put forward an iniquity and a falsehood.
trs.203: Those who disbelieve say: "This (the Qur’ân) is nothing but a lie that he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has invented, and others have helped him at it. In fact they have produced an unjust wrong (thing) and a lie."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

trs.20: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
trs.85: and they say, ‘It is just ancient fables, which he has had written down: they are dictated to him morning and evening.’
trs.22: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has caused to be written: and they are dictated before him morning and evening."
trs.203: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has written down: and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
trs.85: Say, ‘It was sent down by Him who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is all forgiving, all merciful.’
trs.22: Say: "The (Qur'an) was sent down by Him who knows the mystery (that is) in the heavens and the earth: verily He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
trs.203: Say: "It (this Qur’ân) has been sent down by Him (Allâh) (the Real Lord of the heavens and earth) Who knows the secret of the heavens and the earth. Truly, He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا

trs.20: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
trs.85: They also say, ‘What sort of messenger is this? He eats food and walks about in the marketplaces! Why has no angel been sent down to help him with his warnings?
trs.22: And they say: "What sort of a messenger is this, who eats food, and walks through the streets? Why has not an angel been sent down to him to give admonition with him?
trs.203: And they say: "Why does this Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) eat food, and walk about in the markets (as we). Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him?

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا

trs.20: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
trs.85: Why has he not been given treasure or a garden to supply his food?’ and the evildoers say, ‘The man you follow is simply under a spell.’
trs.22: "Or (Why) has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he (not) a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched."
trs.203: "Or (why) has not a treasure been granted to him, or why has he not a garden whereof he may eat?" And the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) say: "You follow none but a man bewitched."

verses.text_uthmani: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: Look how they strike for you comparisons;<sup foot_note=196914>1</sup> but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
trs.85: See what they think you are like! They have gone astray and cannot find the right way.
trs.22: See what kinds of comparisons they make for thee! But they have gone astray, and never a way will they be able to find!
trs.203: See how they coin similitudes for you, so they have gone astray, and they cannot find a (Right) Path.

verses.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا

trs.20: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
trs.85: Exalted is He who can, if He wishes, give you better things than these: Gardens graced with flowing streams, and palaces too.
trs.22: Blessed is He who, if that were His will, could give thee better (things) than those,- Gardens beneath which rivers flow; and He could give thee palaces (secure to dwell in).
trs.203: Blessed be He Who, if He wills will assign you better than (all) that - Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise) and will assign you palaces (i.e. in Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا

trs.20: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
trs.85: It is actually the coming of the Hour that they reject: We have prepared a blazing fire for those who reject the Hour.
trs.22: Nay they deny the hour (of the judgment to come): but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour:
trs.203: Nay, they deny the Hour (the Day of Resurrection), and for those who deny the Hour, We have prepared a flaming Fire (i.e. Hell).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا

trs.20: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
trs.85: When it sees them from a distance, they will hear it raging and roaring,
trs.22: When it sees them from a place far off, they will hear its fury and its ranging sigh.
trs.203: When it (Hell) sees them from a far place, they will hear its raging and its roaring.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا

trs.20: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
trs.85: and when they are hurled into a narrow part of it, chained together, they will cry out for death.
trs.22: And when they are cast, bound together into a constricted place therein, they will plead for destruction there and then!
trs.203: And when they shall be thrown into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they will exclaim therein for destruction.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا

trs.20: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
trs.85: ‘Do not cry out this day for one death, but for many.’
trs.22: "This day plead not for a single destruction: plead for destruction oft-repeated!"
trs.203: Exclaim not today for one destruction, but exclaim for many destructions.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا

trs.20: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
trs.85: Say, ‘Which is better, this or the lasting Garden that those who are mindful of God have been promised as their reward and journey’s end?’
trs.22: Say: "Is that best, or the eternal garden, promised to the righteous? for them, that is a reward as well as a goal (of attainment).
trs.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "Is that (torment) better or the Paradise of Eternity which is promised to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2)?" It will be theirs as a reward and as a final destination.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا

trs.20: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.<sup foot_note=196915>1</sup>
trs.85: There they will find everything they wish for, and there they will stay. [Prophet], this is a binding promise from your Lord.
trs.22: "For them there will be therein all that they wish for: they will dwell (there) for aye: A promise to be prayed for from thy Lord."
trs.203: For them there will be therein all that they desire, and they will abide (there forever). It is a promise binding upon your Lord that must be fulfilled.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ

trs.20: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
trs.85: On the Day He gathers them all together with those they worship beside Him, He will say, ‘Was it you [false gods] who led these creatures of Mine astray, or did they stray from the path by themselves?’
trs.22: The day He will gather them together as well as those whom they worship besides Allah, He will ask: "Was it ye who let these My servants astray, or did they stray from the Path themselves?"
trs.203: And on the Day when He will gather them together and that which they worship besides Allâh [idols, angels, pious men, saints]<sup foot_note=154750>1</sup>. He will say: "Was it you who misled these My slaves or did they (themselves) stray from the (Right) Path?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا

trs.20: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
trs.85: They will say, ‘May You be exalted! We ourselves would never take masters other than You! But You granted them and their forefathers pleasures in this life, until they forgot Your Reminder and were ruined.’
trs.22: They will say: "Glory to Thee! not meet was it for us that we should take for protectors others besides Thee: But Thou didst bestow, on them and their fathers, good things (in life), until they forgot the Message: for they were a people (worthless and) lost."
trs.203: They will say: "Glorified be You! It was not for us to take any Auliyâ’ (Protectors, Helpers) besides You, but You gave them and their fathers comfort till they forgot the warning, and became a lost people (doomed to total loss).

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا

trs.20: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say,<sup foot_note=196917>1</sup> and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice<sup foot_note=196916>2</sup> among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
trs.85: [God will say], ‘Now your gods have denounced what you say as lies: you cannot avoid the punishment; you will not get any help.’ If any of you commits such evil, We shall make him taste agonizing torment.
trs.22: (Allah will say): "Now have they proved you liars in what ye say: so ye cannot avert (your penalty) nor (get) help." And whoever among you does wrong, him shall We cause to taste of a grievous Penalty.
trs.203: Thus they (false gods - all deities other than Allâh) will belie you (polytheists) regarding what you say (that they are gods besides Allâh): then you can neither avert (the punishment), nor get help. And whoever among you does wrong (i.e. sets up rivals to Allâh), We shall make him taste a great torment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا

trs.20: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
trs.85: No messenger have We sent before you [Muhammad] who did not eat food and walk about in the marketplace. But We have made some of you a means of testing others- will you stand fast? Your Lord is always watching.
trs.22: And the messengers whom We sent before thee were all (men) who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for Allah is One Who sees (all things).
trs.203: And We never sent before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) any of the Messengers but verily, they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you as a trial for others: will you have patience? And your Lord is Ever All-Seer (of everything).

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا

trs.20: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves<sup foot_note=196918>1</sup> and [become] insolent with great insolence.
trs.85: Those who do not fear to meet Us say, ‘Why are the angels not sent down to us?’ or ‘Why can we not see our Lord?’ They are too proud of themselves and too insolent.
trs.22: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety!
trs.203: And those who expect not a Meeting with Us (i.e. those who deny the Day of Resurrection and the life of the Hereafter) said: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and are scornful with great pride.<sup foot_note=154751>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

trs.20: The day they see the angels<sup foot_note=196920>1</sup> - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."<sup foot_note=196919>2</sup>
trs.85: There will be no good news for the guilty on the Day they see the angels. The angels will say, ‘You cannot cross the forbidden barrier,’
trs.22: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether!"
trs.203: On the Day they will see the angels - no glad tidings will there be for the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners) that day. And they (angels) will say: "All kinds of glad tidings are forbidden to you," [none will be allowed to enter Paradise except the one who said: Lâ ilâha illallâh, "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) and acted practically on its legal orders and obligations. See the footnote of V.2:193)].

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا

trs.20: And We will approach [i.e., regard]<sup foot_note=196921>1</sup> what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
trs.85: and We shall turn to the deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.
trs.22: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about.
trs.203: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners) did, and We shall make such deeds as scattered floating particles of dust.

verses.text_uthmani: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا

trs.20: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
trs.85: But the companions in the Garden will have a better home on that Day, and a fairer place to rest.
trs.22: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
trs.203: The dwellers of Paradise (i.e. those who deserved it through their Islamic Monotheistic Faith and their deeds of righteousness) will, on that Day, have the best abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا

trs.20: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds,<sup foot_note=196922>1</sup> and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
trs.85: On the Day when the sky and its clouds are split apart and the angels sent down in streams,
trs.22: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
trs.203: And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا

trs.20: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
trs.85: on that Day, true authority belongs to the Lord of Mercy. It will be a grievous Day for the disbelievers.
trs.22: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (Allah) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the misbelievers.
trs.203: The sovereignty on that Day will be the true (sovereignty), belonging to the Most Gracious (Allâh), and it will be a hard Day for the disbelievers (those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.<sup foot_note=196923>1</sup>
trs.85: On that Day the evildoer will bite his own hand and say, ‘If only I had taken the same path as the Messenger.
trs.22: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Messenger!
trs.203: And (remember) the Day when the Zâlim (wrong-doer, oppressor, polytheist) will bite at his hands, he will say: "Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).<sup foot_note=154752>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا

trs.20: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one<sup foot_note=196924>1</sup> as a friend.
trs.85: Woe is me! If only I had not taken so and so as a friend-
trs.22: "Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend!
trs.203: "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as a Khalîl (an intimate friend)!

verses.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا

trs.20: He led me away from the remembrance<sup foot_note=196926>1</sup> after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."<sup foot_note=196925>2</sup>
trs.85: he led me away from the Revelation after it reached me. Satan has always betrayed mankind.’
trs.22: "He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!"
trs.203: "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder (this Qur’ân) after it had come to me. And Shaitân (Satan) is to man ever a deserter in the hour of need." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا

trs.20: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."<sup foot_note=196927>1</sup>
trs.85: The Messenger has said, ‘Lord, my people treat this Quran as something to be shunned,’
trs.22: Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense."
trs.203: And the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur’ân (neither listened to it, nor acted on its laws and teachings).

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا

trs.20: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
trs.85: but We have always appointed adversaries from the wicked, for every prophet: Your Lord is sufficient guide and helper.
trs.22: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help.
trs.203: Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, criminals). But Sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا

trs.20: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.<sup foot_note=196928>1</sup>
trs.85: The disbelievers also say, ‘Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?’ We sent it in this way to strengthen your heart [Prophet]; We gave it to you in gradual revelation.
trs.22: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually.
trs.203: And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Qur’ân revealed to him all at once?" Thus (it is sent down in parts), that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages. (It was revealed to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم in 23 years.).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

trs.20: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
trs.85: They cannot put any argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and the best explanation.
trs.22: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof).
trs.203: And no example or similitude do they bring (to oppose or to find fault in you or in this Qur’ân), but We reveal to you the truth (against that similitude or example), and the better explanation thereof.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
trs.85: It is those driven [falling], on their faces,to Hell who will be in the worst place- they are the furthest from the right path.
trs.22: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray.
trs.203: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the (Straight) Path.<sup foot_note=154753>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا

trs.20: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
trs.85: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron to help him.
trs.22: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister;
trs.203: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah)], and placed his brother Hârûn (Aaron) with him as a helper;

verses.text_uthmani: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا

trs.20: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
trs.85: We said, ‘Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs.’ Later We destroyed those people utterly.
trs.22: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction.
trs.203: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

trs.20: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers,<sup foot_note=196929>1</sup> We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
trs.85: The people of Noah, too: when they rejected their messengers, We drowned them and made them an example to all people. We have prepared a painful torment for the evildoers,
trs.22: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty;-
trs.203: And Nûh’s (Noah) people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا

trs.20: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well<sup foot_note=196930>1</sup> and many generations between them.
trs.85: as We did for the people of Ad, Thamud, and al-Rass, and many generations in between.
trs.22: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them.
trs.203: And (also) ‘Âd and Thamûd, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا

trs.20: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
trs.85: To each of them We gave warnings, and each of them We destroyed completely.
trs.22: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
trs.203: And for each (of them) We put forward examples (as proofs and lessons), and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin (because of their disbelief and evil deeds).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا

trs.20: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.<sup foot_note=196931>1</sup>
trs.85: These disbelievers must have passed by the town that was destroyed by the terrible rain––did they not see it? Yet they do not expect to be raised from the dead.
trs.22: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection.
trs.203: And indeed they have passed by the town [of Prophet Lût (Lot)] on which was rained the evil rain. Did they (disbelievers) not then see it (with their own eyes)? Nay! But they used not to expect any resurrection.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا

trs.20: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
trs.85: Whenever they see you [Prophet] they ridicule you: ‘Is this the one God has sent as a messenger?
trs.22: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?"
trs.203: And when they see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they treat you only in mockery (saying): "Is this the one whom Allâh has sent as a Messenger?

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
trs.85: He might almost have led us astray from our gods if we had not stood so firmly by them.’ When they see the punishment, they will know who is furthest from the path.
trs.22: "He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path!
trs.203: "He would have nearly misled us from our âlihah (gods), had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the (Right) Path!

verses.text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

trs.20: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
trs.85: Think [Prophet] of the man who has taken his own passion as a god: are you to be his guardian?
trs.22: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him?
trs.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him who has taken as his ilâh (god) his own vain desire? Would you then be a Wakîl (a disposer of his affairs or a watcher) over him?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.<sup foot_note=196932>1</sup> Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
trs.85: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle- no, they are further from the path.
trs.22: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path.
trs.203: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are only like cattle - nay, they are even farther astray from the Path (i.e. even worse than cattle).

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا

trs.20: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.<sup foot_note=196933>1</sup>
trs.85: Do you not see how your Lord lengthens the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it stand still- We made the sun its indicator-
trs.22: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide;
trs.203: Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still - But We have made the sun its guide (i.e. after the sunrise, the shadow shrinks and vanishes at midnoon and then again appears in the afternoon with the decline of the sun, and had there been no sunlight, there would have been no shadow).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا

trs.20: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.<sup foot_note=196934>1</sup>
trs.85: but We gradually draw it towards Us, little by little.
trs.22: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
trs.203: Then We withdraw it to Us a gradual concealed withdrawal.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا

trs.20: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing<sup foot_note=196936>1</sup> and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.<sup foot_note=196935>2</sup>
trs.85: It is He who made the night a garment for you, and sleep a rest, and made the day like a resurrection.
trs.22: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection.
trs.203: And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) a repose, and makes the day Nushûr (i.e. getting up and going about here and there for daily work, after one’s sleep at night, or like resurrection after one’s death).

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا

trs.20: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
trs.85: It is He who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His Mercy. We send down pure water from the sky,
trs.22: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky,-
trs.203: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain); and We send down pure water from the sky.

verses.text_uthmani: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا

trs.20: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
trs.85: so that We can revive a dead land with it, and We give it as a drink to many animals and people We have created.
trs.22: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers.
trs.203: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We had created.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

trs.20: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,<sup foot_note=196937>1</sup> but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
trs.85: Many times We have repeated this to people so that they might take heed, but most persist in their ingratitude.
trs.22: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude.
trs.203: And indeed We have distributed it (rain or water) amongst them in order that they may remember (the Grace of Allâh,) but most men (refuse to accept the Truth or Faith and) accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا

trs.20: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.<sup foot_note=196938>1</sup>
trs.85: If it had been Our will, We would have sent a warner to every town,
trs.22: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population.
trs.203: And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا

trs.20: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
trs.85: so do not give in to the disbelievers: strive hard against them with this Quran.
trs.22: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur'an).
trs.203: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them (by preaching) with the utmost endeavour with it (the Qur’ân).

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

trs.20: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
trs.85: It is He who released the two bodies of flowing water, one sweet and fresh and the other salty and bitter, and put an insurmountable barrier between them.
trs.22: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed.
trs.203: And it is He Who has let free the two seas (kinds of water): this is palatable and sweet, and that is salt and bitter; and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا

trs.20: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
trs.85: It is He who creates human beings from fluid, then makes them kin by blood and marriage: your Lord is all powerful!
trs.22: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things).
trs.203: And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He wills.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا

trs.20: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
trs.85: Yet instead of God they worship things that can neither benefit nor harm them: the disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
trs.22: Yet do they worship, besides Allah, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord!
trs.203: And they (disbelievers, polytheists) worship besides Allâh that which can neither profit them nor harm them; and the disbeliever is ever a helper (of the Satan) against his Lord.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

trs.20: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
trs.85: We sent you only to give good news and warning.
trs.22: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
trs.203: And We have sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) only as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
trs.85: Say, ‘I am not asking for any reward for it, but anyone who wishes should take a path to his Lord.’
trs.22: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord."
trs.203: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (that which I have brought from my Lord and its preaching), save that whosoever wills may take a Path to his Lord.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

trs.20: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
trs.85: Put your trust in the Living [God] who never dies, and celebrate His praise. He knows the sins of His servants well enough:
trs.22: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants;-
trs.203: And put your trust (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His Praises, and Sufficient is He as the All-Knower of the sins of His slaves,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

trs.20: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne<sup foot_note=196939>1</sup> - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
trs.85: it is He who created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six Days, and then established Himself on the throne- He is the Lord of Mercy; He is the Best Informed.
trs.22: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): Allah Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things).
trs.203: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days. Then He (Istawâ ) rose over the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). The Most Gracious (Allâh)! Ask Him (O Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , concerning His Qualities: His rising over His Throne, His creations, etc.), as He is Al-Khabîr (The All-Knower of everything i.e. Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩

trs.20: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
trs.85: Yet when they are told, ‘Bow down before the Lord of Mercy,’ they say, ‘What is the Lord of Mercy? Should we bow down before anything you command?’ and they turn even further away.
trs.22: When it is said to them, "Prostrate to (Allah) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (Allah) Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate to that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth).
trs.203: And when it is said to them: "Prostrate yourselves to the Most Gracious (Allâh)! they say: "And what is the Most Gracious? Shall we fall down in prostration to that which you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) command us?" And it increases in them only aversion.

verses.text_uthmani: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

trs.20: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
trs.85: Exalted is He who put constellations in the heavens, a radiant light, and an illuminating moon-
trs.22: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light;
trs.203: Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven big stars, and has placed therein a great lamp (sun), and a moon giving light.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا

trs.20: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
trs.85: it is He who made the night and day follow each other- so anyone who wishes may be mindful or show gratitude.
trs.22: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
trs.203: And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession, for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude.

verses.text_uthmani: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا

trs.20: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily,<sup foot_note=196941>1</sup> and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,<sup foot_note=196940>2</sup>
trs.85: The servants of the Lord of Mercy are those who walk humbly on the earth, and who, when the foolish address them, reply, ‘Peace’;
trs.22: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
trs.203: And the (faithful) slaves of the Most Gracious (Allâh) are those who walk on the earth in humility and sedateness, and when the foolish address them (with bad words) they reply back with mild words of gentleness.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا

trs.20: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
trs.85: those who spend the night bowed down or standing, worshipping their Lord,
trs.22: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
trs.203: And those who spend the night in worship of their Lord, prostrate and standing.<sup foot_note=154754>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

trs.20: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
trs.85: who plead, ‘Our Lord, turn away from us the suffering of Hell, for it is a dreadful torment to suffer!
trs.22: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
trs.203: And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

trs.20: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
trs.85: It is an evil home, a foul resting place!’
trs.22: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
trs.203: Evil indeed it (Hell) is as an abode and as a place to rest in.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا

trs.20: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
trs.85: They are those who are neither wasteful nor niggardly when they spend, but keep to a just balance;
trs.22: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
trs.203: And those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor niggardly, but hold a medium (way) between those (extremes).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا

trs.20: And those who do not invoke<sup foot_note=196942>1</sup> with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
trs.85: those who never invoke any other deity beside God, nor take a life, which God has made sacred, except in the pursuit of justice, nor commit adultery. (Whoever does these things will face the penalties:
trs.22: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
trs.203: And those who invoke not any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh, nor kill such person as Allâh has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse - and whoever does this shall receive the punishment.<sup foot_note=154755>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا

trs.20: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
trs.85: their torment will be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and they will remain in torment, disgraced,
trs.22: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
trs.203: The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

trs.20: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
trs.85: except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds: God will change the evil deeds of such people into good ones. He is most forgiving, most merciful.
trs.22: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
trs.203: Except those who repent and believe (in Islâmic Monotheism), and do righteous deeds; for those, Allâh will change their sins into good deeds, and Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.<sup foot_note=154756>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا

trs.20: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
trs.85: People who repent and do good deeds truly return to God.)
trs.22: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion;-
trs.203: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then verily, he repents towards Allâh with true repentance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا

trs.20: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
trs.85: [The servants of the Lord of Mercy are] those who do not give false testimony, and who, when they see some frivolity, pass by with dignity;
trs.22: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
trs.203: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا

trs.20: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
trs.85: who, when reminded of their Lord’s signs, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them;
trs.22: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
trs.203: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

trs.20: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes<sup foot_note=196943>1</sup> and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
trs.85: those who pray, ‘Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and offspring. Make us good examples to those who are aware of You’.
trs.22: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
trs.203: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the Muttaqûn(the pious. See V.2:2)."

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا

trs.20: Those will be awarded the Chamber<sup foot_note=196944>1</sup> for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
trs.85: These servants will be rewarded with the highest place in Paradise for their steadfastness. There they will be met with greetings and peace.
trs.22: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
trs.203: Those will be rewarded with the highest place (in Paradise) because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.

verses.text_uthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

trs.20: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
trs.85: There they will stay- a happy home and resting place!
trs.22: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
trs.203: Abiding therein - excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

trs.20: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"<sup foot_note=196946>1</sup> For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.<sup foot_note=196945>2</sup>
trs.85: [Prophet, tell the disbelievers], ‘What are you to my Lord without your supplication? But since you have written offthe truth as lies, the inevitable will happen.’
trs.22: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the disbelievers): "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied (Him). So the torment will be yours for ever (inseparable, permanent punishment)."
